administration.title: Administration hierarchy
administration.introduction: Rolkat Financial Services SMC Ltd. Serving you better.

services.title: Micro Loans
services.description: Fast, flexible small credit for boda boda cyclists, small traders, and daily earners with daily or weekly repayment options and 24-hour approval.

services.title: Small Business Loans
services.description: Working capital and modest expansion financing for retail shops, kiosks, and established enterprises assessed on real cash-flow.

services.title: Group Loans
services.description: Solidarity lending for trader groups, market associations, and boda boda stages with mutual guarantees and weekly collections.

services.title: Emergency Loans
services.description: Same-day rapid credit for unexpected medical expenses, motorcycle repairs, or time-sensitive inventory emergencies.

services.title: Market Vendor Loans
services.description: Tailored daily working capital for fresh food sellers and market stallholders to buy morning stock and repay each evening.

services.title: Tenant Sourcing & Screening
services.description: Comprehensive vetting of tenant National IDs, background references, and income viability compliant with the Landlord and Tenant Act, 2022.

services.title: Rent Collection & Remittance
services.description: Disciplined rent collection on due dates, official electronic receipting, arrears follow-up, and timely net remittances to owners.

services.title: Property Maintenance & Repairs
services.description: Routine upkeep and prompt coordination of emergency repairs (plumbing, electrical, structural) using thoroughly vetted contractors.

services.title: Diaspora & Absentee Landlord Oversight
services.description: Dedicated caretaking, condition inspections with photographic reports, utility tracking, and transparent monthly accounting for owners living abroad.

services.title: Land & Plot Sales
services.description: Connecting buyers and sellers with verified residential and commercial plots across Mailo, Freehold, and Leasehold land tenures.

services.title: Property Sales & Leasing
services.description: Professional listing, advertising, and negotiation for residential homes, apartment blocks, commercial shops, and office suites.

services.title: Title Search & Due Diligence
services.description: Rigorous land registry searches, boundary surveys, encumbrance verifications, and legal support to safeguard clients against property fraud.
